22:* `Roth.normOne P`: the ℓ¹ norm `∑ |a_e|` of the coefficients of `P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ`.

47:noncomputable def normOne (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) : ℝ := ∑ d ∈ P.support, |((P.coeff d : ℤ) : ℝ)|
50:theorem normOne_nonneg (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) : 0 ≤ normOne P :=

59:theorem normOne_monomial (e : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : ℤ) : normOne (monomial e c) = |(c : ℝ)| := by
66:theorem normOne_zero : normOne (0 : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) = 0 := by
67:  simp [normOne]
72:    |((P.coeff d : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ normOne P :=
75:/-- The triangle inequality for `normOne`. Source: §3, proof of Lemma 3 ("The triangle inequality
77:theorem normOne_add_le (P Q : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) : normOne (P + Q) ≤ normOne P + normOne Q := by
85:/-- `normOne` is invariant under negation. -/
86:theorem normOne_neg (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) : normOne (-P) = normOne P := by
87:  simp [normOne]
89:/-- The triangle inequality for `normOne` over a finite sum. -/
91:    normOne (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, normOne (f i) :=
92:  Finset.le_sum_of_subadditive normOne normOne_zero.le normOne_add_le s f
94:/-- `normOne` is submultiplicative.
96:theorem normOne_mul_le (P Q : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) : normOne (P * Q) ≤ normOne P * normOne Q := by
100:  rw [normOne, normOne, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
104:/-- `normOne` is submultiplicative over a finite product. -/
106:    normOne (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, normOne (f i) :=
107:  Finset.le_prod_of_submultiplicative_of_nonneg normOne normOne_nonneg
110:/-- A polynomial with coefficients bounded by `B` has `normOne` at most `#support * B`.
114:    normOne P ≤ P.support.card * B := by
115:  simpa [normOne] using P.support.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ (fun d _ ↦ hB d)
117:/-- The determinant of an `l × l` matrix whose entries have `normOne` at most `C` has `normOne`
120:    (hM : ∀ μ ν, normOne (M μ ν) ≤ C) : normOne M.det ≤ l.factorial * C ^ l := by
123:  calc _ ≤ ∑ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l), normOne (_ * ∏ i, M (τ i) i) := normOne_sum_le _ _
145:/-- A Hasse derivative of a polynomial with `deg_{X_j} P ≤ r_j` increases `normOne` by at most a
149:    (hP : ∀ j, degreeOf j P ≤ r j) : normOne (hasseDeriv d P) ≤ 2 ^ (∑ j, r j) * normOne P := by
153:  rw [normOne, Finset.mul_sum]
265:  calc _ ≤ normOne (Matrix.of fun μ ν : Fin l ↦ hasseDeriv (E μ ν) P).det :=
